name: Worm King

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 Personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Grotesque Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 4 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Decaying Miasma
abilities.text: When this Threat takes a Wound, roll 1d6. On an Icon, noxious Warp-tainted gas and effluent spurts from the wound, hitting everyone in range with the following profile: Decaying Miasma: 3+4ED / AP -4 / Blast (7), Inflict (Poisoned 4)

abilities.name: Embrace of Worms
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Worm King's worms make an opposed Strength Test against the target. If they succeed, the target is Restrained and takes 12 + 1ED damage until freed. If this reduces the target to 0 Wounds, it is dragged screaming into the Worm King's gut and digested, replenishing a number of Wounds equal to the target's Toughness. Breaking free requires an opposed Strength Test from the target or 1 or more allies.

abilities.name: Spawn-Kin
abilities.text: Spend 2 Ruin. The Worm King bellows and drives his pack of Chaos Spawn to greater savagery. Each Chaos Spawn immediately makes a Move and Combat Action, even if they had already acted this Round.

determination: Disgustingly Resilient: Roll 7d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds, and does not require Ruin.
note: Decaying Miasma has no printed range, kept as ability text. Infected Ripper Gun's 'Poisoned (6)' stored Inflict (Poisoned 6).
